messages:
jordan-sales: @samir quick heads-up — customer POC (org: acme-corp) getting 403 on /v1/generate, they see "Invalid API key" in the client. POC deadline today, can we triage?

samir-eng: ok, ping me the request + logs. do they pass any org/project headers? could be org/project mismatch or scopes.

jordan-sales: sending snippet they ran from their terminal:
```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-test-XXXX" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rwkv-13b","input":"hello"}'
```
They said they set "X-Redwood-Org: acme-corp" in their UI but not sure that made it to the request.

maria-devops: access-bot shows token validation failed for sk-test-XXXX: org_id mismatch -> token belongs to org "acme-corp-legacy", request header has "acme-corp". @samir could also be a scope problem (e.g., no write scope).

samir-eng: likely they copied a key from the wrong org (common). If token belongs to a different org we return 403 with a generic org/project mismatch message. Ask them to use the key from the POC invite or create a project-level key.

jordan-sales: customer insists the key is from the invite. they redacted it but pasted the first 8 chars. can we verify? or create a temporary key for them while we sort permissions?

laura-se: we can issue a short-lived key under our sandbox and share via secure note. keep scope minimal (inference.write). also watch for 429 if they hit rate limits during test.

ryan-ps: extra check — if the key is project-scoped and missing "inference.write" we return 403 with "insufficient scopes". make sure they use the right header: `X-Redwood-Project: <project-id>` vs `X-Redwood-Org`. new client libs auto-populate.

access-bot: system: debug trace created for token sk-test-XXXX id=tok_9f3a trace_id=tr_2024-06-10-11-12-33 -> org=acme-corp-legacy scopes=["inference.read"] rate_limit_remaining=120

samir-eng: trace shows only "inference.read" — no write scope. that would cause generate to fail. please ask them to try a project key with write scope or request an upgraded key from the POC console.

jordan-sales: I'll ask them to pull the project API key from the POC console and set header `X-Redwood-Project: poc-acme-1`. will report back.

--- 8 minutes later ---

jordan-sales: update — they tried the new key and still get 403 but error changed to "project not found". they used `poc-acme-1` but I think they copied the ID wrong.

samir-eng: checking traces — looks like their request used project id `poc-acme-1` but our records show project id `poc-acme-prod`. they likely used an old invite. I'll regenerate a fresh project invite and create a short-lived key.

access-bot: system: created new project key tok_shortlived id=tok_ab12 scope=["inference.write"] expires_in=3600 project_id=poc-acme-prod

samir-eng: actions: (1) eng created short-lived project key for them; (2) sales confirm they try that key and header `X-Redwood-Project: poc-acme-prod`; (3) eng: consider improving error surface to hint expected project id (careful with PII).

jordan-sales: will send key via secure channel to customer and confirm. thanks all. :raised_hands:
